blocks.en:
---
name: principle-foundational-thinking
description: "Apply before writing logic: choosing core types and data structures, sequencing scaffold-vs-feature work, asking what concurrent actors share. Get the data structures right so downstream code becomes obvious."
disable-model-invocation: true
---
blocks.zh:
---
name: principle-foundational-thinking
description: "在编写逻辑之前使用：选择核心类型和数据结构、安排基础结构与功能的先后顺序、审视并发参与者共享什么。先把数据结构设计对，后续代码自然清晰。"
disable-model-invocation: true
---

blocks.en: **Structural decisions** protect option value. **Code-level decisions** protect simplicity.
blocks.zh: **结构决策**保留未来选择的余地。**代码层决策**保持简洁。

blocks.en: **Data structures first.** Get the data shape right before writing logic. Define core types early, trace every access pattern, and choose structures that match the dominant paths.
blocks.zh: **数据结构优先。**编写逻辑前先确定数据形态。尽早定义核心类型，追踪每种访问模式，选择适合主要路径的数据结构。

blocks.en: At code level, DRY the structure, not every line. Types and data models should converge. Three similar statements still beat a premature abstraction. Prefer explicit over clever. Test behavior and edge cases, not line counts.
blocks.zh: 在代码层面，消除结构上的重复，而不是每一行重复。类型和数据模型应趋于统一。三条类似语句仍然优于过早抽象。选择明确易懂的写法，而非巧妙写法。测试行为和边界情况，不要测试代码行数。

blocks.en: **Concurrency corollary.** Before sharing state between actors, ask "what happens if another actor modifies this concurrently?" If not "nothing", isolate.
blocks.zh: **并发推论。**参与者共享状态前，先问：“另一个参与者同时修改它会发生什么？”如果答案不是“什么也不会发生”，就隔离状态。

blocks.en: **Scaffold first.** If something helps every later phase, do it first. Ask "does every subsequent phase benefit from this existing?" CI, linting, test infrastructure, and shared types are scaffold. Sequence for option value: setup before features, tests before fixes. Keep commits small and single-purpose.
blocks.zh: **基础结构优先。**如果某项工作对所有后续阶段都有帮助，就先做它。问：“它已经存在，是否会让每个后续阶段受益？”CI、lint、测试基础设施和共享类型都属于基础结构。按保留选择余地的原则排序：先准备环境，再实现功能；先写测试，再修复问题。每次提交保持小且目的单一。

blocks.en: Each increment should land a coherent abstraction or deepen one that exists. Do not spread a new capability across callers as special-case coordination.
blocks.zh: 每次增量应交付一个完整一致的抽象，或加深已有抽象。不要把新能力分散到各调用方，通过特例协调来实现。

blocks.en: Subtraction comes before scaffolding. Remove dead code first, then lay foundations.
blocks.zh: 做减法先于搭建基础结构。先删除死代码，再奠定基础。
